content.value_statement: WooCommerce reviewers need consistent checks across PHP, JavaScript, tests, documentation, and UI copy. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to flag project-specific violations with clear fixes.
actual_capabilities: Flags WooCommerce backend architecture and dependency injection violations.
Checks PHP naming, docblock, and @since annotation expectations.
Reviews test naming, @testdox usage, and preferred test variable names.
Identifies JavaScript barrel self-import patterns that can create circular dependencies.
Checks UI copy for sentence case using WooCommerce copy guidance.
Provides a structured review format with issue, location, standard, and fix.
limitations: Requires access to the code change or pull request diff being reviewed.
Relies on related WooCommerce skills for complete standards and examples.
Does not run tests, linters, or static analysis tools by itself.
May need human judgment for public API exceptions and migration cases.

use_cases.title: Pre-merge pull request review
use_cases.description: Review changed WooCommerce files before merge and flag standards issues with precise fixes.

use_cases.title: Local contributor self-check
use_cases.description: Check local changes against WooCommerce conventions before opening a pull request.

use_cases.title: Automated review assistance
use_cases.description: Generate focused review notes for architecture, documentation, testing, and UI copy standards.
use_cases.target_user: Engineering team using AI review workflows

prompt_templates.title: Review a small change
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one changed file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this WooCommerce code change for coding standards compliance. Flag only clear violations and include the location, standard, and fix.

prompt_templates.title: Check a pull request diff
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this pull request diff using the WooCommerce code review skill. Group related issues and focus on backend, frontend, tests, and UI copy.

prompt_templates.title: Audit backend PHP patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these WooCommerce PHP changes for architecture, dependency injection, naming, docblocks, @since annotations, and data integrity concerns.

prompt_templates.title: Run a release-quality review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before a high-risk merge.
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a strict WooCommerce review of this full change set. Cite the specific skill standard for each issue and separate blockers from optional improvements.

output_examples.input: A pull request adds a public method without a docblock or @since annotation.
output_examples.output: The review flags missing documentation, cites the affected method location, references the WooCommerce standard, and suggests adding concise docs and @since.

output_examples.input: A JavaScript file imports from its package barrel and the barrel re-exports that file.
output_examples.output: The review identifies the circular barrel import risk, explains the build impact, and recommends importing the direct module path.

output_examples.input: A UI button label uses title case, such as Save Changes.
output_examples.output: The review flags sentence-case noncompliance and recommends Save changes unless the text includes a proper noun or acronym.

best_practices: Provide the full diff or changed files so review comments can cite precise locations.
Ask for blocker-level findings first when reviewing large pull requests.
Consult the linked WooCommerce standards when a rule needs more context.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill as a replacement for tests, linters, or security review.
Do not request broad style rewrites without a concrete WooCommerce standard.
Do not ignore documented exceptions for public APIs, acronyms, or brand names.

faq.question: Does this skill run code or tests?
faq.answer: No. It reviews provided code or diffs and gives standards-based comments.

faq.question: Which languages does it cover?
faq.answer: It focuses on WooCommerce PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, tests, documentation, and UI copy.

faq.question: Can it review a full pull request?
faq.answer: Yes, if the diff or changed files are available in the active workspace or prompt.

faq.question: Does it know every WooCommerce rule?
faq.answer: It summarizes key violations and points to related WooCommerce skills for complete standards.

faq.question: Is it only for maintainers?
faq.answer: No. Contributors can use it before opening a pull request.

faq.question: Can it decide whether to merge a pull request?
faq.answer: No. It provides review findings, but maintainers decide merge readiness.
